gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2024. GDP 613,000,245,773 2011 int$ (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD rebased x 0.8005) / population 11,513,149 = 53,243 2011 int$. Range +/-10%. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

gdp.note: asOf 2024. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 765,771,699,903 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 613,000,245,773 2011 int$. Range +/-10% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank: last published value 5.64% of GDP (2014); SIPRI has no UAE data since. Range 4-6% is an educated band; stale figure, hence grade C.

industrialShare.note: asOf 2024: industry incl. construction (and hydrocarbons) 44.3% of GDP (NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). Range +/-7% for oil-price swings.

foodSurplus.note: Recomputed 2026-10-29 under the definition: 0.0 -> 0.94. Formula: surplus = 1 - a/s, a = farm population share of consumers (proxy: agricultural employment share, World Bank SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS, ILO modelled, https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/ARE/indicator/SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS), s = domestic production / consumption (calorie self-sufficiency). a = 1.44% (2025). s from FAOSTAT Food Balance Sheets (https://bulks-faostat.fao.org/production/FoodBalanceSheets_E_All_Data.zip): production / domestic supply summed over all FBS items, each weighted by kcal per tonne (world median of food kcal / food tonnes per item); feed, processing and non-food uses stay in domestic supply. s = 0.26 (mean 2021-2023, range 0.22-0.33). Mid 1 - 0.014/0.26 = 0.94. Low: a x 1.5 (farm households larger than the employed count), s 0.22 = 0.9. High: s 0.33 = 0.96. Import dependence: domestic production covers about 26% of domestic calorie supply. Earlier net-trade reading: Educated guess. Imports ~90% of food.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 7,342,214 x share of males aged 15-19 3.733% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 54,814. Male population from SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN. Males only (conscript-pool convention). Range +/-10% for single-year cohort variation. Includes expatriate youths; Emirati males are a small fraction (~15%).

roadKm.note: asOf 2026: 104,311 km, all paved, 253 km controlled-access.

railKm.note: asOf 2021: 279 route-km (World Bank IS.RRS.TOTL.KM). Etihad Rail stage 2 (opened 2023-26) extends the network to roughly 900-1,200 km (high, educated).

majorPorts.note: CIA Factbook 2024: 20 ports, 1 large + 4 medium = 5; key ports Abu Dhabi, Ruwais, Khor Fakkan, Jebel Ali, Zirku.

merchantTonnage.note: asOf 2025: UAE is not in the list of flags over 1,000,000 GT, so under ~1.6 million DWT; mid is an educated guess. UAE-owned tonnage is largely foreign-flagged.

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. Expeditionary logistics proven in Yemen, Libya (airlift + sealift).

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Mainly camels; not from FAO data.

nuclearWarheads.note: The UAE is not listed among the nine nuclear-armed states in the FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026 table. Civil Barakah nuclear power plant only (123 Agreement forgoes enrichment).

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.1: local supply and familiar desert; little depth, small citizen population.

notes: WARTIME-adjacent snapshot: struck by Iranian missiles and drones in the 2026 Iran war and retaliated (Gulf News 26 Mar 2026: 11 dead, 2 soldiers and 9 civilians incl. a Moroccan contractor of the armed forces, https://gulfnews.com/uae/government/iran-attacks-in-uae-leave-11-dead-and-169-wounded-so-far-1.500487256). asOf 2024-25 economic data, 2026 order of battle. Population: all residents inside ne:ARE, ~88% expatriates; mobilization ratio set low accordingly. Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011. Counts from the UAE Army equipment list, Air Force and Navy inventory tables. No ships_major (no frigates/destroyers). Doctrine archetype-modern-regional rather than small-state because of the UAE's independent expeditionary record. Infantry P-role splits are educated guesses (grade D). Overseas positions (Mayun, Berbera) are reported facilities whose current status is uncertain. Audit follow-up 2026-10-29: 12 civilians -> 9 civilians, Gulf News confirms 9 civilian dead (8 civilians + 1 contractor) as of 26 Mar 2026.
